name: Musashibou Benkei
source:
A warrior monk from the late Heian period. She is one of Yoshitsune's Four Heavenly Kings. She trained at Mount Hiei, but was expelled due to her violent temperament. She devised a plan to steal a total of 1000 swords in Kyoto. What's more, she stole not from weak, ordinary people, but specifically from warriors of the Taira clan, and has succeeded in collecting 999.

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming[/url]]
